verdict.rationale: Convex provides an official MCP server and agent-setup docs that let external AI agents (e.g., Claude, Cursor) query, debug, and modify a Convex deployment, and the docs explicitly target coding-agent workflows. However, there is no evidence of an AI assistant embedded directly in the Convex dashboard itself—the capability is delivered via MCP/CLI integration with third-party agents rather than an in-product chat assistant.
